description_en: A curved sofa with a crescent-shaped woven base, segmented seat cushion and sweeping back rail; the front shows the concave seating arc, the side reveals changing seat depth, and the rear shows a convex woven back with evenly spaced radial frame uprights. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. CRITICAL CAMERA CORRECTION: Angle correction is critical: orbit EXACTLY 90 degrees to the object's RIGHT from its centered front opening direction. Photograph the END PROFILE of the entire crescent sofa with its near right outer woven end/back structure in the foreground; do not give a three-quarter interior view and do not present the front cushion row toward the camera. At pure right elevation the broad front opening is edge-on and the outside curved woven wall hides most cushion faces. Use a long lens with horizontal camera at sofa center height. Preserve the exact five seat/back cushion bays, sweeping semicircular frame, square open weave, natural finish and all legs.
